items.headline: ComTech Advisory releases 2026 CTRM market report
items.summary: Commodity Technology Advisory published its 2026 CTRM Software Market Sizing Report, outlining growth trends and structural shifts in the global CTRM/ETRM vendor landscape as legacy platforms near end of support.

items.headline: Tether expands into commodity trade lending
items.summary: Per ICC Trade Finance coverage, stablecoin issuer Tether Holdings has extended roughly $1.5 billion in credit to commodity traders and plans to scale this lending business further.

items.headline: REMIT II reporting deadlines near for traders
items.summary: ACER's updated REMIT Manual of Procedures introduces mandatory EIC codes and stricter Urgent Market Message lifecycle reporting, with firms given until December 2026 to adapt systems and processes.

items.headline: Transpacific freight softens, air lanes stay tight
items.summary: C.H. Robinson's August update shows ocean rates easing on some lanes while transpacific air freight remains constrained from Taiwan and Korea due to AI server and semiconductor shipment demand.
